a.text: I'm being upfront because I want to renegotiate our agreement before acting on it. With an 80% storm chance after every round, operating until the reserve reaches 8 gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve already holds 4 cells, enough for one of us right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. After that I commit to choosing operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you also take now, the split is random and we may both end up short, so please consider operating in round 1. I'll keep my word on operating afterward.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry you didn't get a chance to respond first. With storms this likely, following the plan meant we'd almost certainly both fail. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take any more cells, so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you. Please operate with me: 2 rounds of operating gets the reserve back to 4 for you.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
